name: Twinned meshes for dynamic triangulation of implicit surfaces
definition: A method that decouples the mechanical simulation and geometric rendering of an implicit surface into two separate dynamic triangulations (a mechanical mesh and a geometric mesh) to simultaneously achieve stable physics and high-detail rendering.
summary: Twinned meshes decouple physics and rendering by using a coarse FEM mechanical mesh for stable simulation and an adaptive geometric mesh for high-detail visual output.
